result.detail: Gaps against the specs, for the reviewer and tech lead. (1) interface_spec section 6 and microarchitecture section 5 call for an unbounded SymbiYosys proof at N=4 and N=5 (rr_arbiter.sby and rr_arbiter_n5.sby). This task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench only, and formal.run takes exactly one .sby, so no formal_spec is submitted. The properties are in the RTL, ready for a follow-up formal task that runs at N=4 and at N=5 (not a power of two). (2) microarchitecture section 5 also lists rr_arbiter_tb_fail.v, which shows that a failure path makes a failed run. It is not included here and can be added as follow-up work. (3) The testbench resets the wait counters on reset cycles, because the spec freezes the pointer during reset, and it counts waits in cycles, since every grant lasts one cycle. No tool has been run by this seat.
